refinements.descriptionEn: CRIT Rate increases by 10%. Dash Attack Electric DMG increases by 40%. When any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly or Stuns an enemy, the equipper's CRIT Rate increases by an additional 10% for 15s.

basic.name: 普通攻击：穿云
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的穿透攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
第五段攻击命中敌人时，可生成2枚[电壶]；
发动[连携技]后，悠真下一次发动[普通攻击：穿云]第五段命中敌人时，可生成6枚[电壶]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to five piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
When the 5th hit of the Basic Attack hits an enemy, it generates 2 Electro Quivers.
After activating a Chain Attack, the next time Harumasa activates the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer and hits an enemy with it, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.

special.name: 特殊技：天罗
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发射箭矢，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launch an arrow forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：地网
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发射飞刃和强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
强化箭矢命中敌人或地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launch daggers and an enhanced arrow ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：藏锋
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Pierces enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：会·离
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动穿透攻击，并发射强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
箭矢命中地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead then fire an enhanced arrow, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the arrow hits the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：残心
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动强力穿透攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：穿弦
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：构身
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：构身·斩
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动连续斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash a series of slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: [冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]的暴击率提升25%，悠真的[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]命中敌人并触发暴击时，将获得1层[锋芒]，同一招式内最多获得3层，[锋芒]最多叠加6层，持续5秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；每层[锋芒]会使[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]造成的暴击伤害提升12%。
facts.textEn: The CRIT Rate of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash increases by 25%, and when Harumasa's Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash triggers a critical hit against an enemy, he gains 1 stack of Gleaming Edge, for up to a maximum of 3 stacks per use of the skill and stacking up to 6 times, lasting 5s, repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of Gleaming Edge increases the CRIT DMG of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash by 12%.

cinema.name: 「意气风发」
cinema.description: [普通攻击：甲乙矢]中，[电囚]效果的叠加层数上限提升至14层；[电壶]被激活时，将会向目标连续发射2支[甲乙矢]。
cinema.descriptionEn: The maximum stack limit of Electro Prison from Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya increases to 14 stacks. When an Electro Quiver is triggered, 2 consecutive Ha-Oto no Ya will be fired at the target.

cinema.name: 挥霍
cinema.description: 发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，悠真获得7层[电掣]，最多叠加7层；拥有[电掣]时，[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]造成的伤害提升50%；[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]结束后，消耗1层[电掣]。
cinema.descriptionEn: When using an Chain Attack or Ultimate, Harumasa gains 7 stacks of Electro Blitz, up to a max of 7 stacks. While possessing Electro Blitz, the DMG of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash increases by 50%. Consume 1 stack of Electro Blitz once Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash ends.

cinema.name: 白色谎言
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 偶有充盈
cinema.description: [电囚]效果的持续时间提升至20秒；[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]命中敌人时，悠真获得30点喧响值，同一招式内最多触发一次；发动[终结技]时，将为场上所有敌人施加满层[电囚]效果。
cinema.descriptionEn: Electro Prison now lasts for 20s. When Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash hits enemies, Harumasa gains 30 Decibels once per use of this skill. Upon activating Ultimate, apply the maximum stacks of Electro Prison to all on-field enemies.

cinema.name: 无人知晓
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 会心
cinema.description: [甲乙矢]命中处于失衡状态或属性异常状态下的敌人后，悠真将无视其15%电属性伤害抗性，持续12秒；[甲乙矢]每命中同一名敌人12次，将额外触发1次电磁爆炸，对目标造成悠真1500%攻击力的电属性伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: After Ha-Oto no Ya hits Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomalies, Harumasa will ignore 15% of the target's Electric RES for 12s. Every 12 times an enemy is hit by Ha-Oto no Ya, trigger an extra electromagnetic explosion, dealing 1,500% of Harumasa's ATK to the target as Electric DMG.

basic.name: 普通攻击：穿云
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的穿透攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
第五段攻击命中敌人时，可生成2枚[电壶]；
发动[连携技]后，悠真下一次发动[普通攻击：穿云]第五段命中敌人时，可生成6枚[电壶]。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to five piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
When the 5th hit of the Basic Attack hits an enemy, it generates 2 Electro Quivers.
After activating a Chain Attack, the next time Harumasa activates the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer and hits an enemy with it, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.

basic.name: 普通攻击：穿云·移形
basic.description:
[普通攻击：穿云]发动期间，拖曳摇杆并点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
发动远程穿透攻击，并向拖曳方向调整身位，对前方敌人造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
During Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, drag the joystick and press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Shoot a ranged piercing attack and reposition towards the corresponding drag direction, dealing Physical DMG.

basic.name: 普通攻击：落羽
basic.description:
第五段[普通攻击：穿云]、[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]或[连携技]发动后，长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
立即向前方敌人发射[落羽]，造成电属性伤害。
长按 【普通攻击键】 瞄准目标，松开 【普通攻击键】 发动：
引弓瞄准敌人后，向目标发射[落羽]，造成电属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
After the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, a Special Attack, an EX Special Attack, or a Chain Attack, hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Immediately shoot Falling Feather at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Hold [Basic Attack] to aim at a target and release [Basic Attack] to activate:
After drawing the bowstring and aiming, shoot Falling Feather at the target, dealing Electric DMG.

basic.name: 普通攻击：甲乙矢
basic.description:
第五段[普通攻击：穿云]/[强化特殊技]/[连携技]命中敌人或地面时，可生成2/6/6枚[电壶]；
若场上不存在[电壶]，队伍中任意角色对敌人施加属性异常效果时，可生成6枚[电壶]，12秒内最多触发一次；
[电壶]同一时间内最多存在6枚，悠真发射[落羽]命中敌人时，若场上存在[电壶]，则会将其激活，向被[落羽]命中的目标发射[甲乙矢]，造成电属性伤害；
[甲乙矢]命中敌人时，会为其施加[电囚]效果，最多叠加8层，持续10秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，[电囚]效果大于等于2层时，将在目标身上生成[十文字]标记。
basic.descriptionEn:
When the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer/EX Special Attack/Chain Attack hits an enemy or the ground, it can generate 2/6/6 Electro Quivers. If there are no Electro Quivers on the field when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, generate 6 Electro Quivers. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
There can be up to 6 Electro Quivers present at a time. If there are any Electro Quivers present when Harumasa fires and hits enemies with Falling Feather, the Electro Quivers will activate and fire Ha-Oto no Ya at the enemies hit by Falling Feather, dealing Electric DMG.
Ha-Oto no Ya will apply Electro Prison to enemies hit, stacking up to 8 times and lasting 10s, repeated triggers reset the duration. While a target has at least 2 stacks of Electro Prison, they will be X-Marked.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：飞弦
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行多段穿透攻击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Launch multiple piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩
basic.nameEn: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
basic.description:
当场上存在拥有[十文字]标记的敌人时，悠真会进入[醒觉]状态，并将[冲刺攻击：飞弦]替换为[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]。
[醒觉]状态下，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速突进至距离自身最近的带有[十文字]标记的敌人身前，发动强力斩击，造成电属性伤害；
斩击命中目标时会消耗2层[电囚]效果，[电囚]效果少于2层时，将消除[十文字]标记；在[十文字]标记耗尽前，连续点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可连续发动[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]；当场上不存在带有[十文字]标记的敌人时，悠真将退出[醒觉]状态；
[醒觉]状态下，[普通攻击：落羽]发动后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以快速衔接发动[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
basic.descriptionEn:
While there are X-Marked enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the Awakened state, switching Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru for Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.

While in the Awakened state, press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Rush forwards to the closest X-Marked enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing Electric DMG.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of Electro Prison. With less than 2 stacks of Electro Prison, X-Marked will be removed from the enemy. Before X-Marked is removed, repeatedly press [Basic Attack] to repeatedly use Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash. While no X-Marked enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the Awakened state.
While in the Awakened state, press [Basic Attack] after Basic Attack: Falling Feather to quickly follow up with Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发射箭矢，造成电属性伤害；

Launch an arrow forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：地网
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Nowhere to Run
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方发射飞刃和强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
强化箭矢命中敌人或地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launch daggers and an enhanced arrow ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：残心
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动强力穿透攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：穿弦
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

120100001.name: 普通攻击：穿云
120100001.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多五段的穿透攻击，造成物理伤害和电属性伤害；
第五段攻击命中敌人时，可生成2枚[电壶]；
发动[连携技]后，悠真下一次发动[普通攻击：穿云]第五段命中敌人时，可生成6枚[电壶]。
120100001.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to five piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
When the 5th hit of the Basic Attack hits an enemy, it generates 2 Electro Quivers.
After activating a Chain Attack, the next time Harumasa activates the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer and hits an enemy with it, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.

120100003.name: 普通攻击：落羽
120100003.description:
第五段[普通攻击：穿云]、[特殊技]、[强化特殊技]或[连携技]发动后，长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
立即向前方敌人发射[落羽]，造成电属性伤害。
长按 【普通攻击键】 瞄准目标，松开 【普通攻击键】 发动：
引弓瞄准敌人后，向目标发射[落羽]，造成电属性伤害。
120100003.descriptionEn:
After the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, a Special Attack, an EX Special Attack, or a Chain Attack, hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Immediately shoot Falling Feather at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Hold [Basic Attack] to aim at a target and release [Basic Attack] to activate:
After drawing the bowstring and aiming, shoot Falling Feather at the target, dealing Electric DMG.

120100011.name: 连携技：会·离
120100011.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动穿透攻击，并发射强化箭矢，造成大量电属性伤害；
箭矢命中地面时，可生成6枚[电壶]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
120100011.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead then fire an enhanced arrow, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the arrow hits the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

120100016.name: 快速支援：穿弦
120100016.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
120100016.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

120100050.name: 冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩
120100050.nameEn: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
120100050.description:
当场上存在拥有[十文字]标记的敌人时，悠真会进入[醒觉]状态，并将[冲刺攻击：飞弦]替换为[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]。
[醒觉]状态下，闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
快速突进至距离自身最近的带有[十文字]标记的敌人身前，发动强力斩击，造成电属性伤害；
斩击命中目标时会消耗2层[电囚]效果，[电囚]效果少于2层时，将消除[十文字]标记；在[十文字]标记耗尽前，连续点按 【普通攻击键】 ，可连续发动[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]；当场上不存在带有[十文字]标记的敌人时，悠真将退出[醒觉]状态；
[醒觉]状态下，[普通攻击：落羽]发动后，点按 【普通攻击键】 可以快速衔接发动[冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩]；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
120100050.descriptionEn:
While there are X-Marked enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the Awakened state, switching Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru for Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.

While in the Awakened state, press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Rush forwards to the closest X-Marked enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing Electric DMG.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of Electro Prison. With less than 2 stacks of Electro Prison, X-Marked will be removed from the enemy. Before X-Marked is removed, repeatedly press [Basic Attack] to repeatedly use Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash. While no X-Marked enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the Awakened state.
While in the Awakened state, press [Basic Attack] after Basic Attack: Falling Feather to quickly follow up with Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

120100050.name: 冲刺攻击：飞弦·斩
120100050.nameEn: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
